svg.aria-label: 2233admin — software that keeps working after the lights go out. A wolf-eared maid in a tracksuit jacket with a mechanical arm squats on a rain-soaked rooftop beside a black cat, looking back at the viewer; behind her a derelict giant robot, ruined arches, a rocket launch and a ringed planet over a retro-futurist city.

g.text: SOFTWARE THAT KEEPS WORKING AFTER THE LIGHTS GO OUT
